li.label: Radio Amateur
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} feels a strange sense of peace when exposed to radiation. Perhaps {PAWN_pronoun} sees something beautiful in it... or is simply broken.

li.label: graveyard fashionista
li.description: [PAWN_nameDef] believes the best outfits are the ones that have already buried someone. Why waste resources on a new jacket when some poor sap already did all the dirty work breaking it in? After all, dead men tell no fashion tales. Or any tales. They're dead.

TraitDef.label: toxic
TraitDef.description: This character enjoys the suffering of others and never misses an opportunity to insult someone.

li.label: toxic
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} periodically walks around and insults others. When someone nearby has a mental break, {PAWN_nameDef} feels a strange satisfaction.

li.label: music enthusiast
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves music. The sounds of melodies deeply touch {PAWN_possessive} soul, doubling {PAWN_possible} mood. They say back in pre-war days, such people were called connoisseurs of the beautiful. Now it's just a way not to lose {PAWN_possessive} mind to the silence of the wasteland and {PAWN_possessive} own thoughts.

li.label: misophone
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} hates music. Any melodies irritate {PAWN_objective}, causing headaches and discomfort. In the wasteland, most people would kill for a working radio. {PAWN_possessive} just wishes someone would finally put that ancient piece of junk out of its misery — and preferably before the next chorus.
